SELECT uv.*, a.area_name AS area_name, u1.user_name AS manager_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, u2.user_name AS report_name, d.name AS dept_name, u3.user_name AS handle_name, hs.name AS handle_status_name, u4.user_name AS review_name, rr.review_result_name AS review_result_name, ps.name AS plan_status_name, pt.name AS problem_type_name, tt.name AS task_type_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u5.user_name), '') AS staffs_name_str FROM urban_village uv LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON uv.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON uv.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON uv.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON uv.report_by = u2.user_id AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON uv.dept_id = d.sys_dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON uv.handle_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON uv.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u4 ON uv.review_by = u4.user_id AND u4.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_review_result rr ON uv.review_result_id = rr.review_result_id AND rr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON uv.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_problem_type pt ON uv.problem_type_id = pt.sys_problem_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON uv.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0 -- 处理负责人员JSON解析 LEFT JOIN sys_user u5 ON FIND_IN_SET( u5.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(uv.staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u5.deleted = 0
GROUP BY uv.id, a.area_name, u1.user_name, os.name, u2.user_name, d.name, u3.user_name, hs.name, u4.user_name, rr.review_result_name, ps.name, pt.name, tt.name
ORDER BY uv.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uv.id) FROM urban_village uv LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON uv.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON uv.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON uv.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON uv.report_by = u2.user_id AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON uv.dept_id = d.sys_dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON uv.handle_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON uv.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u4 ON uv.review_by = u4.user_id AND u4.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_review_result rr ON uv.review_result_id = rr.review_result_id AND rr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON uv.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_problem_type pt ON uv.problem_type_id = pt.sys_problem_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON uv.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0
